user.title: Access Control
user.description: Only what is needed to start is configured here. Cards, gates, hooks and thresholds are managed from the Access panel.

data_description.nearby_zone: When an adult enters it, the system switches to adult return.
data_description.door_contact_entity: A second source independent of the lock: if the two disagree it is a fault or a forced entry.

scan.name: Evaluate a scan
scan.description: Injects a credential read as if it came from a reader.

enroll_card.name: Enroll a card
enroll_card.description: Adds a card to the registry or updates an existing one.

remove_card.name: Delete a card
remove_card.description: Removes the card from the registry.

unlock_readers.name: Unlock readers
unlock_readers.description: Clears the lockout and the consecutive failure count.

clear_log.name: Clear the access log
clear_log.description: Deletes every row of the log.
